title: Mr. District Attorney
paragraphs: A crime drama centered on an unnamed district attorney and his staff as they investigate and prosecute racketeers, killers, corrupt officials, and other criminals.

Crime/procedural franchise centered first on an unnamed crusading district attorney (Jay Jostyn), then on Paul Garrett in the Ziv transcribed David Brian version, followed by a late Mutual Jostyn return. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 84 playable objects across these phases.

GRH documents the program through Blue Network launch era (April 3, 1939 to April 7, 1940) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], NBC/Bristol-Myers era (April 11, 1940 to 1951-08) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], ABC final network season (1951-09 to June 13, 1952) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], and Ziv transcribed Paul Garrett version (August 10, 1952 to August 4, 1953) on [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Phillips H. Lord (creator on 45 recordings and performer on 5 recordings), [[person|jay-jostyn|Jay Jostyn]] (performer on 24 recordings), Len Doyle (performer on 22 recordings), Vicki Vola (performer on 22 recordings), David Brian (performer on 21 recordings), Peter Van Steeden (music director on 11 recordings and music on 3 recordings), and Robert Shaw (writer on 8 recordings and director on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]] (syndicated by), [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by), and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by).
